prompts.name: elian-north
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one square character portrait for Behind the Screens, a fictional 1980s television management game.
Style: carefully hand-pixelled retro adventure-game portrait, approximately 128x128 logical pixels enlarged with crisp square pixel edges, restrained dithering, limited harmonious colour palette, expressive but natural face, premium late-1980s computer-game character art. No photorealistic rendering, no smooth vector gradients.
Composition: exactly one fictional adult, head and shoulders, centered with entire hair and shoulders visible, face at consistent scale filling about two thirds of the square, gentle three-quarter angle, looking toward camera. Flat dark desaturated teal/navy backdrop, warm studio light, understated period clothing. Readable at small card size.
Constraints: no lettering, name, logo, watermark, border, UI, collage or additional people. No celebrity likeness. Opaque background.
Subject: Male, age about 60, fair skin, silver side-parted hair, short neat silver beard, thoughtful warm expression, round brown spectacles, brown corduroy blazer and cream open-collar shirt. Distinguished, approachable science presenter.
